findings.claim: The plan ties the template version to the kmctl pin ("one tag"; just upgrade runs copier update --vcs-ref REF --data kmctl_ref=REF), but it keeps a validator that accepts any vX.Y.Z, and r3 requires [claude] with v0.5.0 to render. Two things follow. (a) A project rendered from the v0.6.0 template with kmctl_ref v0.5.0 has _commit v0.6.0 and pin v0.5.0, so the two are not one tag. Its own `just upgrade v0.5.1` then fails, because no kmctl tag before the first release with the template has a copier.yml. (b) copier 9.19 refuses a downgrade ("You are downgrading from X to Y. Downgrades are not supported.", copier/_main.py:1381). So `just upgrade` can no longer move a project to an older kmctl release, which the recipe's own help offers today ("Move to another kmctl release, such as v0.5.0"), and the how-to row r8 promises without limits ("just upgrade vX.Y.Z moves both"). The plan has to choose. One option: raise the validator floor to the first template-carrying release (which retires the separate v0.5.1 OpenCode floor) and say upgrade only moves forward. The other: keep pins older than the template, and have upgrade and the docs say what happens to them. r3, r4 and r8 then follow that choice.

The template-version/pin coupling conflicted with the validator's v0.4.0 floor and copier's downgrade refusal under --vcs-ref. The revision drops --vcs-ref from just upgrade, keeps the template at the newest release with kmctl_ref choosing the CLI and package, drops r4, and r8 documents that model. This is the same decoupling kmctl-starter had, so no upgrade path is lost.

The how-to and ADR 0025 say that after a kmctl release with no template change, `uvx copier update` changes nothing. It does change something: copier rewrites `_commit` in .copier-answers.yml to the new tag, so the project gets a one-line diff to commit at every release. That is the cost the operator accepted, so the docs should say so.

The how-to's table still describes the generated .pre-commit-config.yaml as 'Generic hooks only'. It does not mention the new exclude, which leaves the agent files APM and kmctl plugin patch install (.agents/, .claude/agents|rules|skills/, .opencode/, opencode.json) unchecked. A user who adds a hook and sees it skip those files has nothing to explain why.

entries.change: copier update after an unchanged release rewrites only _commit; the hooks row names the installed agent files the hooks skip.
Consequences say copier update then changes only _commit, a one-line change to commit.
